description: Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education - Order Made under Section 20 (4) (b) Appointment of Competent Authority - University of Ruhuna
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Harini Amarasuriya, Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education) AND detailed responsibilities/authorities being assigned (appointing a Competent Authority to exercise powers of the Vice-Chancellor of University of Ruhuna due to administrative dislocation). This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed responsibilities being delegated).
